name: City of San José
disclaimer: Verify with City of San José Planning Division and Building Division. San José has an active ADU program.

notes: San José has a streamlined ADU permit process.
City offers pre-approved ADU plans to reduce permit timeline.
Some Specific Plan areas (Alviso, Rincon South) may have additional rules.
Hillside areas subject to additional grading and geotechnical requirements.
